name: fountain
$comment: Fountain's components as a chant workspace (https://intentius.io/chant/reference/workspace-declaration/). No member is a chant project, so each is kind other with the reason chant does not read it. The root keeps config/, rel/, scripts/, standards/, contributing/, changelog.d/ and .github/.

members.name: server
members.because: the Phoenix server (AGPL-3.0), built by mix from the umbrella root

members.name: ee
members.because: credits, Stripe and the credit emails (Elastic 2.0), compiled into :fountain (ADR 0010, 0027)

members.name: ext-buzz
members.because: a first-party extension OTP app (ADR 0043, 0054), with its Go CLI in cli/

members.name: ext-support
members.because: a first-party extension OTP app (ADR 0043, 0054)

members.name: ext-google
members.because: a first-party extension OTP app contributing a connection provider (ADR 0054)

members.name: ext-microsoft
members.because: a first-party extension OTP app contributing a connection provider (ADR 0054)

members.name: ext-slack
members.because: a first-party extension OTP app contributing a connection provider (ADR 0054)

members.name: cli
members.because: the fountain Go CLI (Apache-2.0), its own Go module

members.name: sdk-contract
members.because: the wire contract projected from the server's OpenAPI document, which every SDK is checked against; regenerating it boots the server, so its generator is not listed here

members.name: sdk-conformance
members.because: the scenario matrix the four SDKs are run against

members.name: sdk-typescript
members.because: the TypeScript SDK, published as @managoat/fountain-sdk; its generated openapi.ts needs dist/openapi.json, which only the server writes

members.name: sdk-python
members.because: the Python SDK

members.name: sdk-elixir
members.because: the Elixir SDK, its own mix project

members.name: sdk-swift
members.because: the Swift SDK, built through Package.swift at the repo root (ADR 0041)

members.name: deployed
members.because: the verifier that drives a deployed instance, with its browser harness in browser/

members.name: deploy
members.because: Kubernetes manifests and Grafana dashboards for running Fountain

members.name: images
members.because: sandbox images for the Daytona and E2B providers

members.name: integrations
members.because: third-party agent integrations

members.name: examples
members.because: example agents and the quickstart; none is a chant project, so they are not an example group

members.name: templates
members.because: the managoat library template

members.name: docs
members.because: the public manual, served at /docs

members.name: decisions
members.because: the ADRs, an OKF bundle
